title: Create Home Loan Application
description: Customer creates a new home loan application by providing personal details, employment information, and the desired loan amount and property.

title: Save Draft
description: Customer saves an in-progress application as a draft to complete later without losing entered data.

title: Resume Draft
description: Customer resumes a previously saved draft application and continues from where they left off.

title: Update Application
description: Customer updates details of an application that has not yet been submitted for review.

title: Upload Supporting Documents
description: Customer uploads supporting documents (ID, payslips, bank statements, property papers) required for the application.

title: Delete Draft
description: Customer deletes a draft application that is no longer needed.

title: Submit Application
description: Customer submits a completed application for processing; KYC must be completed before submission is allowed.

title: Track Application Status
description: Customer views the current status of a submitted application as it moves through the approval pipeline.

title: Customer Identity Verification
description: System verifies the customer's identity against submitted ID documents before proceeding with eligibility checks.

title: Age Validation
description: System validates that the applicant meets the minimum applicant age of 18 years.

title: Citizenship Validation
description: System validates the applicant's citizenship/residency status against program eligibility rules.

title: Employment Verification
description: System verifies the applicant's employment status and employer details.

title: Income Verification
description: System verifies the applicant's income using payslips or bank statements issued within the last 6 months.

title: Existing Debt Assessment
description: System reviews the applicant's existing debt obligations as an input to the credit assessment.

title: AML Screening
description: System screens the applicant against anti-money-laundering (AML) sanctioned-party lists before KYC approval.

title: KYC Approval
description: System finalizes KYC approval once identity, age, citizenship, and AML checks have all passed.

title: Add Property
description: Customer adds the property being purchased or used as collateral to the application.

title: Property Ownership Verification
description: System verifies legal ownership of the property against the submitted title/ownership documents.

title: Property Address Validation
description: System validates the property address for completeness and correctness.

title: Property Type Validation
description: System validates that the property type is eligible as collateral under lending policy (e.g., agricultural land is excluded).

title: Property Valuation
description: System records the appraised property valuation, valid for 90 days from the assessment date.

title: Loan-to-Value Calculation
description: System calculates the loan-to-value (LTV) ratio and enforces the maximum LTV of 80%.

title: Insurance Validation
description: System validates that required property insurance is in place before property approval.

title: Property Approval
description: System finalizes property approval once ownership, valuation, and insurance checks pass.

title: Credit Score Assessment
description: System assesses the applicant's credit score to support the lending decision.

title: Debt-to-Income Calculation
description: System calculates the debt-to-income (DTI) ratio and enforces the maximum DTI of 40%.

title: Maximum Loan Calculation
description: System calculates the maximum loan amount the applicant qualifies for based on income, DTI, and LTV limits.

title: Interest Rate Calculation
description: System calculates the applicable interest rate, including any eligible promotional rates.

title: Repayment Schedule Calculation
description: System generates the repayment schedule based on loan amount, interest rate, and tenure (maximum 35 years).

title: Manual Review
description: System routes borderline applications to a loan officer for manual review.

title: Conditional Approval
description: System supports conditional approval of an application pending outstanding conditions.

title: Loan Approval
description: Branch manager approves the loan application once all assessment criteria are satisfied.

title: Loan Rejection
description: System records the rejection of an application that fails eligibility, credit, or policy checks.

title: Generate Loan Contract
description: System generates the loan contract document based on approved loan terms.

title: Digital Signature
description: Customer digitally signs the loan contract using a valid, non-expired certificate.

title: Accept Terms
description: Customer accepts the loan terms and conditions prior to disbursement.

title: Schedule Disbursement
description: System schedules the disbursement of loan funds after contract signing.

title: Execute Disbursement
description: System executes a single, idempotent transfer of loan funds to the customer.

title: Customer Notification
description: System notifies the customer of key contract and disbursement milestones.

title: Loan Activation
description: System activates the loan only after disbursement has been confirmed.

title: Disbursement Confirmation
description: System confirms successful disbursement and records the confirmation.

title: View Repayment Schedule
description: Customer views the current repayment schedule for an active loan.

title: Repayment Processing
description: System processes a scheduled repayment against an active loan.

title: Partial Repayment
description: System accepts a partial repayment and recalculates the outstanding balance.

title: Early Settlement
description: System calculates the payoff amount, including any early settlement penalty, using the currently effective rate.

title: Penalty Calculation
description: System calculates penalties for late or early repayment events.

title: Loan Statement
description: System generates a loan statement showing repayment history and outstanding balance.

title: Update Customer Profile
description: Customer updates personal/contact details on their profile.

title: Close Loan
description: System closes a loan once fully repaid; a closed loan must no longer accept repayments.

title: Notification History
description: Customer views the history of notifications (SMS/email) sent regarding their loan, without duplicates.
